entwurf.thema: Suno and ElevenLabs for a GTA-style radio station: what free covers and when paying matters

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Your free AI hit can't earn a cent.
teile.szene: Black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses winces in a parked muscle car at night, hand on a retro radio dial, neon city street behind him, painted open-world-game poster style, medium shot.

teile.name: Frage
teile.szene: Cyan-glasses presenter in leather jacket leans on a graffiti wall beside a glowing radio tower at dusk, raised eyebrow, original urban painted game-poster style, wide shot, calm sky above.

teile.name: Beleg
teile.text: Free-plan songs stay non-commercial. Subscribing later won't fix it. Like buying a ticket after the concert.
teile.szene: Presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses stands outside a closed stadium gate at night, empty street, a guard shaking his head, painted open-world-game poster style, medium shot, warm neon light.

teile.name: Aufruf
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter with cyan glasses gives a thumbs up from a rooftop overlooking a neon painted city, medium close shot, evening glow, urban game-poster style.

teile.name: Wendung
teile.szene: Presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses sits at a desk with headphones around his neck, one hand on his chin, curious expression, street-mural city window glowing behind, painted open-world-game poster style, medium shot.

teile.name: Beleg Bezahlt
teile.text: Pro or Premier songs get commercial rights, checked November 18.
teile.szene: Presenter in leather jacket relaxed at a desk with headphones, nodding with a satisfied grin as a neon street-mural city glows through the window behind, painted open-world-game poster style, medium shot, warm lighting.

teile.name: Aufloesung
teile.text: Subscribe first, then it can earn.
teile.szene: Presenter turns a glowing retro car radio dial at night, neon reflections on windshield, confident smirk, painted open-world-game poster style, close shot, calm top and bottom areas.

entwurf.beschreibung: Suno's help page says songs made on the free plan are non-commercial and a later subscription gives no retroactive license. Songs made while subscribed to Pro or Premier carry commercial rights. Checked November 18.
